bsb_words: take a single stick
reason: The figure is 'wood' put for a stick made of wood. BSB says 'stick' outright.

bsb_words: with all your army
reason: BSB gives the meaning 'army' in place of 'power'.

bsb_words: Tell the rebellious house of Israel
reason: The abstract 'rebellion' put for the people becomes 'the rebellious house of Israel', which states the meaning.

bsb_words: anything that makes them perspire
reason: BSB says outright what causes sweat, so 'sweat' no longer stands for the garments.

bsb_words: an insolent king
reason: The face idiom for boldness becomes the plain word 'insolent'; no face word is left.

bsb_words: take away understanding
reason: BSB puts the meaning 'understanding' where the word 'heart' was.

bsb_words: a silly, senseless dove
reason: 'Without heart' becomes the plain word 'senseless'.

bsb_words: the lush vineyards you have planted
reason: 'Vineyards of desire' becomes 'lush vineyards'; nothing is left that carries 'desired'.

bsb_words: to divide the land by lot
reason: 'Cast a cord' becomes the plain words 'divide the land'.

bsb_words: the spears of cypress have been brandished
reason: BSB names the spears outright, so the trees no longer stand for them.

bsb_words: wealth indeed betrays him
reason: BSB has 'wealth' where 'wine' was; nothing carries wine put for its effect.

bsb_words: I have heard the report of You
reason: 'Thy hearing', put for what was heard, is rendered plainly as 'the report'.

bsb_words: they will come with all their treasures
reason: There is no 'desire of all nations'. The BSB reads 'treasures', which is not a figure for Christ.

bsb_words: the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel
reason: 'Stone of tin' is rendered plainly as 'plumb line'.

bsb_words: through the earlier prophets
reason: 'By the hand of' is rendered plainly as 'through'.

bsb_words: This will be the punishment of Egypt
reason: 'Sin', put for its punishment, is rendered plainly as 'punishment'.

bsb_words: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea
reason: The BSB adds 'People', so Jerusalem and Judea are now just places.

bsb_words: News about Him spread all over Syria
reason: 'His hearing' is rendered plainly as 'News about Him'.

bsb_words: if you greet only your brothers
reason: 'Embrace' is rendered plainly as 'greet'.

bsb_words: his good store of treasure
reason: 'Treasure', put for the treasury, is rendered plainly with 'store'.

bsb_words: brings out of his storeroom new treasures
reason: 'Treasure', put for the treasury, is rendered plainly as 'storeroom'.

bsb_words: by the testimony of two or three witnesses
reason: 'Mouth' is rendered plainly as 'testimony'.

bsb_words: rumors of wars
reason: 'Hearing' is rendered plainly as 'rumors'.

bsb_words: gained five more
reason: The KJV 'made them other five' is replaced by the plain meaning 'gained', the word Bullinger uses to explain it.

bsb_words: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea
reason: The BSB says 'People' outright; 'Judea' is now only the place they came from.

bsb_words: she sensed in her body
reason: 'Knew' is rendered by the plain meaning 'sensed', which is what Bullinger says it means: she felt.

bsb_words: messengers from the house of Jairus arrived
reason: The BSB names the house and the messengers outright instead of 'from the ruler'.

bsb_words: all she had to live on
reason: 'All her living' is turned into its plain meaning, her means of support.

bsb_words: warmed himself by the fire
reason: 'Light' is rendered by the plain 'fire'.

bsb_words: acknowledged God's justice
reason: 'Justified God' is replaced by the plain meaning Bullinger gives: declared God to be just.

bsb_words: he divided his property between them
reason: 'His living' is rendered by the plain 'property'.

bsb_words: the sons of this age
reason: 'World' is rendered by the plain meaning 'age', which is what Bullinger gives.

bsb_words: is detestable before God
reason: The noun 'abomination', put for a thing abominated, becomes the plain adjective 'detestable'.

bsb_words: they all contributed out of their surplus
reason: The BSB leaves out "unto the offerings of God" and just says they contributed. No word for the offering chest is left.

bsb_words: will flow from within him
reason: The BSB gives the plain meaning ("from within him") where Bullinger has "belly".

bsb_words: you are unable to accept My message
reason: Bullinger reads "hear" as receiving. The BSB says "accept" outright.

bsb_words: His command leads to eternal life
reason: Bullinger's figure is "is life everlasting". The BSB states the effect outright ("leads to").

bsb_words: wait for the gift the Father promised
reason: The BSB gives Bullinger's plain meaning (the thing promised) in place of "the promise of the Father".

bsb_words: He and all his household
reason: "house" becomes "household", which states the meaning outright, as in the "family" example.

bsb_words: I now truly understand
reason: The BSB gives Bullinger's own plain meaning, "understand", in place of "perceive".

bsb_words: a place of prayer
reason: The BSB says "a place of prayer" outright.

bsb_words: fastened their feet in the stocks
reason: "wood" becomes "stocks", the plain meaning.

bsb_words: He has given proof of this
reason: "faith" is rendered "proof", the plain meaning.

bsb_words: justify the circumcised ... the uncircumcised
reason: The BSB names the persons outright.

bsb_words: but the elect did
reason: The abstract "election" is gone. The BSB names the elect persons outright.

bsb_words: after I have enjoyed your company
reason: "filled with you" is turned into the plain meaning, "your company".

bsb_words: We have become a spectacle
reason: "theatre" is gone. "spectacle" is the plain meaning.

bsb_words: I will find out
reason: "know" is turned into the plain meaning, "find out".

bsb_words: partake of its offerings
reason: "partakers with the altar" becomes "partake of its offerings". The BSB names the offerings outright, and "altar" is now only the place where they serve.

bsb_words: in a race all the runners run
reason: "race-course (stadium)" becomes the plain word "race".

bsb_words: a sign of authority on her head
reason: "power" becomes the plain meaning, "a sign of authority".
